title: 第六章 伊尔莎要抓住未来
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

伊尔莎国际大新闻。

《震惊！魔族王女伊尔莎为夺王位谋害双亲，长期下药致国王身体衰竭而死，现已畏罪潜逃，萨维顿王国发布一级通缉令！》

“据萨维顿方面消息，国王哈尼德尔及其王后西里娜的死因已查明，为长期服用白轧花毒素导致的慢性中毒，身体器官衰竭而亡，

而根据王女伊尔莎·赫戈曼的宫廷老师及其侍女透露，过去两年间伊尔莎曾多次询问白轧花毒素相关问题，并委托侍女秘密购买，私自在动物身上进行实验，并将白轧花毒素混合入糕点中送于王国和王后，魔族审裁庭已于前日在伊尔莎购置的秘密房产内发现大量白轧花毒素提取物及实验设备...

其兄长，魔族皇子安格烈表示，将不会因为其是自己血亲而心慈手软，干出此等罪行，必将严惩不贷，目前已于全世界范围下下达通缉令，任何包庇，窝藏，支持罪犯伊尔莎的行为都将视为同伙，将受到萨维顿的审判！

另外，皇子安格烈透露，为维持国家系统稳定，自己将尽快登基，接手帝国权柄....”

伊尔莎的手不知觉的握紧了幻网通，心脏像是被捏紧了一般，呼吸困难。

虽然早有预料，但真正看到这些诬陷自己的消息后，还是被强烈的愤怒占据头脑。

当时她是看着父王和母后死在安格烈面前的，那个对权力无比疯狂的男人，为此不惜残害自己的双亲，做出这种畜生不如的事，还将一切罪责全丢到了她的身上。

这个新闻板块里还有着访谈视频，其中就有她的宫廷老师文森特，对着镜头控诉王女的罪恶。

“文森特老师...为什么您也...”

伊尔莎的眼神沉寂下来。

她心里也清楚，文森特老师还有妻子和孩子，为了保全他们，只能屈服于安格烈。

但是看到一直教导她的老师也背叛自己，心中还是泛起了强烈的无助感，仿佛置身于空岛，眼看风暴将至，却孤立无援。

她只看了几眼，就立刻关掉了幻网通，闭上眼，胸口发疼。

缓了好一会儿，她才抬起头，对亚枫说道：

“我现在...已经被通缉了，王城已经没办法去了吧？”

前天他们可以说是赶在了最后的期限返回，而今天她的大头照已经被贴的满大街都是了，下楼丢个垃圾都得被人认出来。

“没关系啊，换个发型就好了。”

亚枫无所谓的说道。

“呃...这恐怕不是换个发型就能解决的吧...”伊尔莎说道。

“放心好了，我是专业的，保证能瞒过所有人的眼睛。”亚枫打了个响指。

三分钟后...

“这，这就是你说的让人看不出来的化妆技术？”伊尔莎看着镜子里的自己，抽动眼角。

“如何？满意吧？”

“但你就给我扎了个双马尾啊！其他什么都没变好吧！”伊尔莎忍无可忍的说道。

亚枫就给她用发夹扎了个双马尾的造型，其他什么都没变，傻子才会认不出她吧？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Big international news for Ilsa.

"shock!The demon princess Ilsa murdered her parents in order to seize the throne, and drugged the king for a long time, causing the king to die of physical exhaustion. Now she is absconding in fear of crime, and the Kingdom of Saviton has issued a first-level wanted order!》

"According to Saviton news, the cause of death of King Hanidel and Queen Sirena has been found out. They died of chronic poisoning caused by long-term use of leucotoxin, and their body organs failed.

According to Princess Ilsa Hegeman's palace teacher and her maid, Ilsa has asked many questions about the toxin in the past two years, and entrusted the maid to buy it secretly, conduct experiments on animals privately, and mix the toxin into cakes and send it to the kingdom and the queen. The Demon Tribunal has discovered a large amount of the toxin extract and experimental equipment in the secret property purchased by Ilsa the day before yesterday...

His brother, the demon prince Angele, said that he will not be merciful because he is his blood relative. Those who commit such crimes will be severely punished. Currently, a wanted order has been issued around the world. Anyone who shields, harbors, or supports the criminal Ilsa will be regarded as an accomplice and will be tried by Saviton!

In addition, Prince Angele revealed that in order to maintain the stability of the national system, he will ascend the throne as soon as possible and take over the power of the empire..."

Ilsa's hand unconsciously clenched Huanwangtong, her heart seemed to be squeezed, and it was difficult to breathe.

Although he had expected it, when he actually saw the news that framed him, he was still filled with intense anger.

At that time, she watched her father and mother die in front of Angele. That man was extremely crazy about power. For this, he did not hesitate to kill his own parents, did such a thing that was worse than an animal, and threw all the blame on her.

There is also an interview video in this news section, in which Vincent, her palace teacher, accuses the princess of her crimes to the camera.

"Teacher Vincent...why do you also..."

Ilsa's eyes fell silent.

She also knew in her heart that Teacher Vincent had a wife and children, and in order to save them, she had no choice but to succumb to Angele.

But when she saw that the teacher who had been teaching her also betrayed her, she still felt a strong sense of helplessness in her heart, as if she was on an empty island, watching the storm coming, but she was alone and helpless.

She only glanced at it for a few times, then immediately turned off Huanwangtong, closed her eyes, and felt a pain in her chest.

After a while, she raised her head and said to Ya Feng:

"I'm...wanted now. I can't go to the royal city anymore, right?"

The day before yesterday, they could be said to have met the deadline to return, but today her mugshot has been posted all over the street, and people will recognize her even if she throws trash downstairs.

"It doesn't matter, just change your hairstyle."

Yafeng said indifferently.

"Uh... I'm afraid this can't be solved by changing your hairstyle..." Ilsa said.

"Don't worry, I'm a professional and I guarantee that I can hide it from everyone's eyes." Ya Feng snapped his fingers.

Three minutes later...

"This, is this your invisible makeup technique?" Ilsa looked at herself in the mirror and twitched the corners of her eyes.

"How is it? Are you satisfied?"

"But you just tied me a pair of ponytails! Nothing else has changed!" Ilsa said unbearably.

Yafeng used hairpins to tie her into a double ponytail shape, and nothing else changed. Only a fool would not be able to recognize her, right?
